title: Prepare occupier statements on fire safety installations
what: Prepare occupier statements on the maintenance of each prescribed fire safety installation, at the intervals the Queensland Development Code sets.

sources.title: Building Fire Safety Regulation 2008 (Qld)
sources.quote: The occupier of a building must, at intervals in compliance with QDC, part MP6.1, prepare a statement (an occupier statement ) that complies with the part about the maintenance of each prescribed fire safety installation for the building

administration.who: Commissioner under the Fire Services Act 1990 (Qld)

sources.title: Building Fire Safety Regulation 2008 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 55A, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: business days after the occupier is required to prepare an occupier statement, give the commissioner a copy of the statement.

reach.condition: if it occupies or manages a building with prescribed fire safety installations
